# Academic Platform Copilot Instructions

- Maintain instant responsiveness across all UI components and page routes without artificial delays.
- Ensure all database queries run in parallel with `Promise.all` where independent.
- Keep secrets in environment variables (`process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`).
- Follow Next.js App Router conventions and keep code cleanly typed with TypeScript.
